exposure: maternal preconception socio-demographic characteristics (age, ethnicity, parity, body mass index, smoking)
outcome: composite outcome of preterm birth and SGA
secondary maternal, delivery, and neonatal complications
cohort: The study included 8340 women from a general population.
finding: Prediction models for birth complications using maternal preconception and early-pregnancy characteristics showed limited predictive performance (AUCs 0.63-0.67), despite small, statistically significant improvements with more complex models.
birth_weight: SGA and LGA were defined as gestational-age-adjusted birthweight in the lowest or highest decile, respectively.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as < 37 weeks gestation; maternal characteristics were collected covering the preconception period and first half of pregnancy (< 21 weeks gestation).
